summary.text: Claude Sonnet, prompt v1, 30 Wikimedia Commons photos, single labeller (draft). Reliable: brand recall 90-93%, gap detection recall 89-100% (false alarms 5% with default prompt v1 in two runs vs 19-29% with v0; image tiling tested, no gain, not used). Unreliable: exact shelf count 48-66% and facings 48-67% across repeat runs, price-tag count within ±2 63-73%. Treat counts as rough; see eval/RESULTS.md. Samples below show model output next to our labels.

model_output.category: wine (Alsace Riesling and Pinot, supermarket aisle)
model_output.notes: Angled aisle shot. The left side is cropped and bottles are packed in depth, so no brand's facings can be fully counted and none are reported. The bottom shelf is cut off by the frame. Four shelf levels are clearly stocked. A fifth upper level is partly visible at top right, but it is mostly cropped and not counted. Labels that read clearly: Auchan 'La Sélection' Riesling, Vin d'Alsace Riesling, Cave du Roi Dagobert Alsace Riesling 2007, and Hunawihr Alsace (Médaille d'Or, Servir 2007). Other labels (pink 'Alsace Riesling Vieilles Vignes', 'Sainte...' and the Pinot Noir bottles) are only partly legible, so no brand names are listed for them. No visibly empty shelf space was found.

Angled view of a long, densely stocked biscuit aisle. Shelf 1 (top) holds Milano, Golden Arcs and boxed assorted biscuits. Shelf 2 holds Parle-G and Parle-G Gold. Shelf 3 holds Parle Marie. Shelf 4 holds 20-20 with more Marie on the right. Shelf 5 holds Krack Jack and 20-20. Packs are stacked and overlap, and the angle compresses the far left, so facings could not be counted fully and are omitted. Shelf 5 is cropped at the bottom of the frame, so the count of 5 may be low. There are no visibly empty stretches on any shelf. Shelf-edge strips are visible, but no price text is legible. Many far-left packs are unreadable, so no other brands are listed.
